artifacts.summary: E3 device-selection research: the box-dot(Fp)/box-dot(Pp) shapes are device-inert on finite fixtures (machine-checked: deterministic 2-state acceptor, pigeonhole lasso-sufficiency); pigeonhole-tier Ramsey refuted on infinite fibres (machine-checked); on infrastructure and literature evidence the substrate should build on the time-axis Ramsey summary (in-tree infinite_ramsey_pairs) framed by the HWZ/GKWZ MSO quasimodel route; Safra/Safraless not selected. No complexity bound claimed.

Compiled research prototype (lake env lean, standard axioms, no warnings): allPathsMeet_iff_lasso, allBwdPathsMeet_iff_lasso, detRun_accepts_iff, not_lasso_sufficient_on_chain. Starting text for the deliverable probe at specs/evidence/seam-gluing-ray-product/device-selection-probe.lean.

memory_candidates.title: Single-operator stab shapes are device-inert on finite fixtures
memory_candidates.content: box-dot(Fp) and box-dot(Pp) are co-safety per-path properties: their acceptor is a 2-state deterministic automaton and their universal summary over any finite step graph reduces to lasso paths by pigeonhole alone (Finite.exists_ne_map_eq_of_infinite on the shifted sequence). They cannot test determinization, Safraless, MSO or Ramsey devices. A discriminating probe needs an infinite (finitely presented) fibre, where pigeonhole-tier lasso sufficiency provably fails.

memory_candidates.title: Infinite Ramsey for pairs lives in-tree, not in Mathlib
memory_candidates.content: FormalSystem.Metalogic.WeakCanonical.infinite_ramsey_pairs (RamseyFactorization.lean) proves infinite Ramsey for pairs on standard axioms; Mathlib v4.33.0-rc1 has only Hindman and Hales-Jewett, no omega-automata, no MSO. Any decidability-side use of Ramsey should import it rather than re-prove it.

memory_candidates.title: Lean arithmetic idioms for lasso constructions
memory_candidates.content: For ultimately periodic index functions with a variable modulus, avoid `set r := a % m` (new occurrences are not abstracted); rewrite with Nat.mod_add_mod / Nat.add_mod_right / Nat.mod_eq_of_lt / Nat.mod_self on the raw expression. `push_neg` is deprecated at this pin (use `simp only [not_exists, not_and]` or `push Not`). `omit [inst] in` must precede the docstring, not sit between docstring and theorem.
